_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate Technical Data Package (TDP)
summary: Specifies the content and format for submitting Specialized Reusable Container Design Drawings as part of a Technical Data Package for specialized reusable container design candidates.
use_relationship: This Data Item Description (DID) specifies the content and format for submitting the Specialized Reusable Container Design Drawings.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

MIL-STD-31000 Department of Defense Standard Practice Technical Data Packages.
(Copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

ASME Y14.100 Engineering Drawing Practices.
(Copies of this document are available online at https://www.asme.org.)

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: A Product Level TDP shall be delivered for the government-approved specialized reusable container design candidate. The TDP shall include engineering analysis and fully defined product definition. At a minimum, each TDP shall include the following data elements:

children.title: Material construction and surface finish of item
Item fragility factor (G's) in shipping/non-operational mode

Special shipping requirements, e.g. attitude, hazardous material, electrostatic discharge sensitivity, protection against emitting or receiving electromagnetic forces, corrosion, controlled temperature, etc.
Physical characteristics (length, width, height, weight, fragility, center of gravity, moments of inertia, lifting features, etc.)
Identification and modeling of specialized handling or support equipment needed for installation or removal, as applicable
Part numbers and, if applicable, serial numbers
Text documents (narrative or procedural info, as applicable)

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: TDP deliverable format is Native 3D models, 3D neutral files (STEP) and 3Di pdf for each TDP. Contractor shall confirm all neutral files are compatible with the following formats: IGES format (.igs, .iges) and STEP format (.stp, .step). 3Di formatting shall address title block, parts list, notes per ASME Y14.100 series of standards and MIL-STD-31000. Refer to MIL-STD-31000 Appendix B for 3Di sample PDF format. Product Drawings/Models and Associated Lists in Native Format shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-31000 paragraph 5.4.1.3. Company standards are not approved; all standards specified shall be industry and/or military standards.
